name: aetna-precert
description: Aetna commercial precertification packet for an initial inpatient (POS 21) lumbar fusion. The 'Aetna Choice POS II' letterhead routes the bundle to the 'aetna' payer bucket (spec-v52 §4.5.7) and engages the Aetna commercial overlay. The packet cites the applicable Clinical Policy Bulletin and attaches a clinical note (R-PA-AETNA-001/002 pass), while R-PA-AETNA-003 passes because Aetna does not require the submission channel in packet content. R-PA-AETNA-005 also passes because the packet does not say Aetna requested its spinal questionnaire. R-PA-AETNA-006 now passes because an initial admission request is not a concurrent review. As an elective surgery in an inpatient setting it surfaces the Outpatient Surgical Procedures site-of-service nudge (R-PA-AETNA-015 info, wave 52-7c).

Clinical note
Chief complaint: low back pain with bilateral leg claudication.
History of present illness: eight months of progressively worsening symptoms.
Physical exam: positive straight-leg raise bilaterally.
Assessment and plan: lumbar spinal stenosis; recommend L4-L5 decompression and fusion.
Medical necessity: MRI confirms severe central canal stenosis at L4-L5.
Note date: 2026-06-01
Signed: Ortho Spine MD, 2026-06-01
